bundle.heading: Support Bundle for a support request
bundle.help: The Support Bundle is a ZIP file with six summary files. It contains no rows of your records, paths, file names, identifiers, exact times, or coordinates. Nothing is uploaded: it is saved next to the output folder.
bundle.review: Review every file in it before you share it.
bundle.review_help: Review all six files before you share it. The counts in it can still show how much you use your device.
check.not_ready: The folder cannot be used for a run yet.
check.ready: The folder can be used for a run.
check.running: Checking the folder. A large export can take a while…
doctor.next_optional: Next: nothing is required. START_HERE.md explains the output.
doctor.next_review_fit: Next: before you use the outputs made from FIT files, check the FIT data that was left out.
doctor.next_review_warnings: Next: before you use the outputs, read the warnings and check which data they affect.
doctor.usability_bounded: Doctor: the outputs can be used with some data left out. The activities output can be used as it is.
doctor.usability_full: Doctor: all outputs can be used within the declared contract.
doctor.usability_warnings: Doctor: the outputs can be used, with the warnings below.
error.activities_not_found: No activities were found. Choose the folder extracted from the Garmin export.
error.bundle_exists: A Support Bundle with this name already exists next to the output. Move or rename it, then try again.
error.bundle_not_written: The Support Bundle could not be written. Check that the output folder is still there and that you can write to the folder that contains it.
error.bundle_refused: The Support Bundle was not made because one of its safety checks failed. Please report the code below.
error.conversion_failed: Part of the export could not be converted.
error.data_conflict: The export contains conflicting values for the same record.
error.folder_not_readable: This folder cannot be opened. On a Mac, allow access when asked, or in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
error.input_changed: Files in the export changed during the run. Run again when nothing else is changing the folder.
error.input_unreadable: Some files in the export could not be read.
error.internal: The run stopped at an internal check. Please report the code below.
error.no_finished_output: There is no finished output from this session. Run Run-All first.
error.not_a_folder: This is a file, not a folder.
error.open_failed: The system could not open it. Open the output folder from your file manager.
error.open_not_available: No program to open it (xdg-open) was found. Open the output folder from your file manager.
error.output_changed: The output folder does not match what the run wrote. If you did not change it, please report the code below.
error.output_exists: A folder with this name already exists. Choose another name.
error.output_inside_input: The output cannot be inside the export folder.
error.output_name_invalid: This folder name cannot be used.
error.output_not_available: The output folder or a file in it is missing, or was replaced by a link.
error.output_parent_not_found: The folder for the output does not exist.
error.output_parent_not_writable: This folder cannot be written, so the output cannot be created in it. Choose another folder, or check its permissions.
error.path_not_absolute: Enter a full path that starts at the top of the drive.
error.publish_failed: The output folder could not be written. Check the free space and the permissions.
error.request_invalid: The entries could not be read. Check them.
error.run_active: A run is already in progress.
error.symlink: Links are not accepted. Choose the real folder.
error.timezone_data_unavailable: Timezone data is missing from this Python installation. Reinstall the package.
error.timezone_invalid: This timezone name is not known. Use a name such as Asia/Tokyo.
